reviews.title: Absolute Dumpster Fire!
reviews.text:
I’ve been on dog socials for a while now and when my previous social got shut down, I downloaded DS to keep up with friends. People here are insane! Dog Scanner is known across many socials as the dumpster fire of a pet social. There are young children running wild, almost no moderation (aside from censoring certain words, which is extremely easy to bypass), *extremely* inappropriate ads, and so much unbelievable content. The advertisements also promote several unethical practices, and I get recommended backyard breeders on the regular. Furthermore, the homophobia on this app is disgusting, and several users have told LGBTQ+ members many horrible comments that I shall not repeat. Please, for the love of anything, stay away from this app.

Also the dog identification doesn’t even work. It just uses AI and gives you a random percentage of what breed your dog looks most like 🫩🙏
